data.one_liner: A procedural audio plugin for Flutter supporting frequency transitions and real-time waveforms.
data.what_it_does: Sound Generator enables procedural audio generation inside Flutter applications with smooth frequency transitions. It supports multiple waveform types such as sine, square, triangle, and sawtooth, and provides real-time signal waveform visualization.
use_when: You need to procedurally generate synthetic sounds or tones within your app.
You want to visualize signal waveforms in real-time.
You require customizable parameters like sample rates, volume, and decibel levels.
avoid_when: You only need to play pre-recorded audio files or streams.
You are building a complex music production DAW that requires multi-track sequencing.
strengths: Supports multiple waveform types (sine, square, triangle, sawtooth).
Cross-platform support for Android and iOS.
weaknesses: Limited to synthetic/procedural audio rather than complex multi-file playback management.
data.setup_notes: Add the plugin to your pubspec.yaml and fetch with flutter pub get. Uses native Android and iOS audio capabilities.

alternatives.name: audioplayers
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick audioplayers if you need to play existing audio files or URLs rather than generating procedural audio.

alternatives.name: just_audio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick just_audio for advanced playback of multiple audio formats, playlists, and streaming from sources.

import 'package:sound_generator/sound_generator.dart';
